alerts.title: Significant weight gain and metabolic changes on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines note the possibility of weight gain with all ART regimens, advising proactive counseling on diet and exercise. The patient has gained 17 kg (BMI increased from 25.6 to 32.4 kg/m²) over 18 months since switching to TLD (TDF/3TC/DTG). She now has acanthosis nigricans, pre-diabetes (fasting glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1%), and dyslipidemia. DTG is a known contributor to weight gain and metabolic complications. Non-drug causes include family history of Type 2 Diabetes and potential lifestyle factors.

evidence.recommended_action: Discuss weight gain risk, counsel on diet and exercise, and intensify monitoring for diabetes and cardiovascular risk.

alerts.title: Missing glucose monitoring per DTG guideline
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend glucose monitoring every 3 months for the first year for people living with HIV transitioned to DTG. The patient was switched to DTG (in TLD) 18 months ago. There is no record of structured glucose monitoring during the first year on DTG, and the patient now presents with impaired fasting glucose and pre-diabetes.

evidence.recommended_action: Implement guideline-recommended glucose monitoring schedule and assess for diabetes.
